title: All work applications other than new buildings and substantial improvements.
officialText:
All work applications other than new
buildings and substantial improvements, shall be subject to the following special inspection:
1. Flood zone compliance special inspection. Prior to sign-off of work, a special inspector or special inspection agency shall
inspect during the course of construction and certify that: “the structure was constructed” or “alterations were performed,”
“with methods and practices that minimize flood damage and that are in accordance with approved plans, and with any
applicable provisions of Appendix G of the New York City Building Code and ASCE 24.”
